about.title: About Me.
about.introLine1: A designer specializing in brand visual and product design.
about.introLine2: My work focuses on building brands from 0–1: visual identity systems, product CMF, packaging, and marketing visuals. Between order and sensibility, I value clear, sustainable expression.
about.introLine3: Over the past year, I've been deeply involved in the full process from system building to product launch in a startup brand environment. Rather than isolated outputs, I focus on how systems are repeatedly used, validated, and evolved in real scenarios.
about.introLine4: For me, design is not about choosing forms, but a continuous practice based on judgment, experience, and long-term perspective.
about.contactIntro: Ready to start your next project?
about.contactIntro2: Whether it's a brand new idea or an ongoing project, I'd love to hear about it first.

phase-01.title: Brand Identity System
phase-01.desc: Establishing a stable and long-term usable visual foundation in the early stage when product direction is not yet clear.

intro.content: In the early stage when the brand has not yet clarified its product scale and communication methods, the primary goal is not to 'design comprehensively', but to establish a visual foundation that is stable enough for long-term use.

core-principles.title: CORE PRINCIPLES
core-principles.subtitle: Three Core Principles of the System

brand-identity.title: Brand Core Architecture
brand-identity.content: The derivation process from core values to visual expression

principles.title: Other Design Principles
principles.content: Determine other design decisions through the stability principle

logo.title: Logo design is not about formal complexity, but structural stability
logo.content: Through simple and controllable structural logic, ensure the logo maintains consistent recognition across different sizes and media.

logo-structure.title: Logo Structure Analysis
logo-structure.content: Through clear structural decomposition, revealing the internal logic and proportional relationships of the logo design.

logo-focus-lens.title: Logo Detail Focus
logo-focus-lens.content: Diving into key details of the logo, showcasing the refined considerations and craftsmanship in design.

logo-variations.title: Logo Variations Exploration
logo-variations.content: From wireframe to final form, documenting the design exploration and decision-making process.

color.title: The color system is established with long-term use as the premise
color.content: Through a limited and clear color range, ensure unified brand perception across different products and scenarios, avoiding visual fatigue caused by short-term trends.

typography.title: Typography supports information expression, not style reinforcement
typography.content: Clear hierarchical relationships ensure the brand maintains a stable reading experience across different content densities.

validation.title: After the system is established, validate through minimum applications
validation.content: These applications are not the final form, but are used to confirm the system's feasibility in real usage scenarios.

summary.title: The outcome of this phase is not a 'complete' brand
summary.content: But a visual foundation that can support subsequent product design and continue to grow through change.

phase-closing.title: Phase Closing
phase-closing.content: Phase one complete. Brand visual foundation established.

phase-02.title: Product A: From Concept to Launch
phase-02.desc: The complete design process of the first product, from concept exploration to final launch.

intro.content: This is a complete product design practice from concept to launch. The project covers design decisions, execution verification, and final launch.
intro.emphasis: This is a product that is truly used.

user-generation.title: Target User Generation Analysis
user-generation.content: Understanding the needs and preferences of different generations.

boundaries.title: Design doesn't start with creativity, but with boundaries
boundaries.content: Before resources, market, and goals are clear, no design can be established.
boundaries.emphasis: Define the problem first, then find the solution.

cmf-main.title: CMF Main Exploration
cmf-main.content: Product main CMF color material finish exploration.

cmf.title: CMF is the key intermediary connecting brand long-term planning with product implementation
cmf.content: It must serve brand expression while also conforming to product function and manufacturing reality.
cmf.emphasis: Aesthetics is not the goal, but the result under constraints.

manufacturing.title: Design decisions must be continuously validated in real manufacturing conditions
manufacturing.content: From materials, components to factory samples, design is always in the feedback loop.
manufacturing.emphasis: Design is not completed in drawings.

priority.title: Different markets require different priority judgments
priority.content: The first batch of solutions is not 'the best looking', but 'the most suitable for market entry'.

packaging.title: Packaging is the user's first interface with the brand
packaging.content: It not only carries information, but also affects users' expectations of product value.
packaging.emphasis: The first touchpoint determines the first judgment.

consistency.title: Consistency is the prerequisite for a brand to be remembered
consistency.content: Regardless of how usage scenarios change, recognition should remain stable.
consistency.emphasis: Recognition is not decoration, but a system result.

closing.title: This product validates the feasibility of the entire design system
closing.content: It provides a reusable reference model for subsequent products and design decisions.
closing.emphasis: This is not a case, but a sample.

phase-03.title: Product B: Consistency with Variation
phase-03.desc: How the second product achieves differentiation while maintaining brand consistency.

intro.content: Building on the existing brand system and first product, the second product's design focus is no longer 'starting from zero', but how to make reasonable changes while maintaining consistency.

concept-comparison.title: Comparison is the most direct way to judge differences
concept-comparison.content: The two products maintain consistency in visual structure, proportion, and core language, while adjusting details according to product characteristics.
concept-comparison.emphasis: Differentiation is change permitted by the system

component-showcase.title: Core components maintain consistent design language
component-showcase.content: From main structure to detail components, design follows the same visual logic and proportion principles.
component-showcase.emphasis: Consistency starts from the component level

slide-grid.title: Slide Presentation
slide-grid.content: Product design specification slide grid showcase.

square-grid.title: Product Grid
square-grid.content: Square product grid scroll reveal showcase.

panorama-marquee.title: Marquee Mixed Display
panorama-marquee.content: Marquee, scene and carousel mixed showcase.

gallery-upper.title: Systematic documentation of design specifications
gallery-upper.content: Complete design guidelines ensure the brand can be consistently expressed at any touchpoint.
gallery-upper.emphasis: Specifications are the guarantee of consistency

gallery-lower.title: Brand extension and application examples
gallery-lower.content: From products to communication materials, brand visuals maintain consistency across various media.
gallery-lower.emphasis: Extension is not copying, it's the natural growth of the system

closing.title: Product B validates the sustainability of the brand system
closing.content: The completion of this phase marks the brand entering a mature stage of replicable expansion.

phase-04.title: Packaging & Marketing Extensions
phase-04.desc: Extending the brand visual system to packaging, marketing, and more touchpoints.

intro.content: As products enter the market, brand visuals no longer exist only under ideal conditions, but need to maintain clarity and consistency across real environments and diverse scenarios.

packaging-grid.title: Packaging Form System
packaging-grid.content: Plastic box, tin box, bullet box series packaging showcase.

closing.title: As the system matures, design begins to truly integrate into the brand's daily operations
closing.content: The completion of this phase also provides a stable foundation for subsequent brand development.

phase-05.title: Retail & Experience Expansion
phase-05.desc: Applying the brand system to retail spaces and user experience scenarios, ensuring offline touchpoints align with the overall brand.

intro.content: As the brand extends from products to spaces, design needs to maintain system integrity and recognition in three-dimensional environments.

kv-kiyomi.title: KIYOMI Key Visual
kv-kiyomi.content: Using a「poster layout system」to modularize key visuals, slogans, products, and scenes, enabling rapid production of high-recognition promotional materials for「offline touchpoints」.

kv-nicotine-drops.title: Nicotine Drops Key Visual
kv-nicotine-drops.content: Using「regional posters」+「scene layering」+「flavor card matrix」visual kits to batch-match promotional needs across「global regions」and「channel terminals」.

photo-cube.title: CUBE Product Photography
photo-cube.content: Through modular delivery of「color system implementation」+「factory follow-up」+「photography validation」+「accessory adaptation」, bringing design from screen to real retail scenarios, accumulating directly usable content assets for subsequent marketing activities.

photo-motor.title: MOTOR Product Photography
photo-motor.content: Through modular accessory design of「silicone case protection」+「lanyard scenarios」, transforming portability and protection value into cross-sellable and shareable marketing assets, supporting terminal display and promotional gift systems.

photo-display.title: Display Stand Photography
photo-display.content: Through modular retail materials of「display cabinet/shelf display」+「terminal selling point packaging」+「wobbler decoration」, systematically implementing sales information for different products at terminals, enhancing display attractiveness and conversion.

photo-store.title: Store Photography
photo-store.content: Through modular review of「cross-country store real-scene validation」, visualizing the actual implementation of materials in different terminals and display environments, helping teams iterate quickly and supporting channel replication.

photo-packaging.title: Packaging Photography
photo-packaging.content: Through modular process of「packaging system sampling」+「photography validation」, aligning color, craftsmanship, information hierarchy, and display effects before mass production, providing reliable finished assets for channel listing and marketing.

photo-expo.title: Exhibition Photography
photo-expo.content: Through modular implementation of「exhibition space visuals」+「interactive installations」+「material systems」, rapidly building and uniformly presenting brand experiences at overseas exhibitions, supporting customer acquisition, guidance, and channel negotiations.

mockups.title: Mockups Showcase
mockups.content: Through modular mockup system of「event scene rendering」+「material kit reuse」, rapidly implementing visuals needed for promotions, displays, and channel communication, improving presentation quality and reuse efficiency.

closing.title: Successful retail implementation marks brand system maturity
closing.content: The system is validated across multi-dimensional scenarios, laying the foundation for continuous brand development.

phase-06.title: Text Visualization
phase-06.desc: Transforming brand narratives into reusable visual modules for channel materials, sales demos, and client communication.

intro.content: Transforming brand narratives into reusable visual modules for channel materials, sales demos, and client communication.

folder-01.content: Using coordinate positioning modules to compare solution differences — channels and clients instantly see 'why choose us.'

folder-02.content: Using radar charts to quantify experience dimensions like flavor, cleanliness, feel, power, draw, and style — enabling channels to compare multiple models at a glance.

folder-03.content: Using 'device + dual pod solution' combo modules to package different use cases and specs into clear layouts, ready for channel presentation and display.

folder-04.content: Using a modular info wall of feature highlights, structural selling points, ecosystem/community, and color SKUs — packaging the full product picture into a one-page channel brief.

folder-05.content: Using a 'three-mode' parameter layering module to translate feel differences into clear options and benefits — letting clients choose by preference and channels explain by script.

folder-06.content: Using a 'normal/silent' state-switching module to present usage scenarios (visible feedback vs. low disturbance) as instantly selectable selling points for scenario-based recommendations.

folder-07.content: Using 'core selling point cards + 3-step usage flow' modular layout to explain functional candy differences and onboarding in one screen — easy for channel training and instant customer understanding.

folder-08.content: Using a 'real user pain-point evidence wall' to condense frequent complaints about old categories into one-screen consensus, laying clear 'replacement reasons' for channels.

folder-09.content: Using a 'Drops vs Pouches' comparison table module to standardize differences in usage, convenience, flavor, and social experience — instant understanding for clients, instant selling for channels.

folder-10.content: Using 'high-frequency persona scenario cards' to package target users and use cases into deployable, trainable materials — helping channels quickly identify key audiences.

folder-11.content: Using a 'consumption evolution timeline' module to connect global and local category migration paths — helping channels quickly grasp market education context and why new products are inevitable.

folder-12.content: Using a 'trend alignment + product positioning' module to place Oi! within the next-gen evolution narrative — one screen explaining 'why now, why this.'

folder-13.content: Using 'demographic data rings + key mindset profile cards' to present target market age groups and purchase motivations in one screen — helping channels quickly lock in key audiences and talking points.

folder-14.content: Using a 'product evolution ladder' comparison to explain experience upgrades and channel profit logic tier by tier — helping channels understand the shift from basic to touchscreen ecosystem.

folder-15.content: Using 'core features + three theme showcases' modular layout to package touchscreen value (clear display, personalization, real-time info) into ready-to-use selling materials.

folder-16.content: Using 'three-mode difference cards' to turn draw intensity and flavor experience choices into instantly selectable purchase scripts for quick channel recommendations.

folder-17.content: Using 'audience manifesto posters + app community scenes' modular narrative to bind 'next-gen users' with brand social value in one screen — helping channels explain join reasons and retention.

folder-18.content: Using 'app key path demos' modular pages to visually package registration, discovery, following, and friending flows — supporting channel training and quick customer onboarding.

folder-19.content: Using 'near-field connection (NFC) scenario' modular selling points to present offline social triggers and instant interaction as instantly understandable functional value for in-store experience guidance.

folder-20.content: Using 'membership benefits + point tasks + reward drops' modular benefits wall to visually package community retention and repurchase mechanisms into a one-screen benefits narrative — helping channels directly explain 'what you get by joining.'
